reason: The potato stems are fading, so the basket should let me lift and collect the crop.
expectation: I expect to harvest potatoes from the trough into the basket, though I don't know how much has grown.

effect: The harvest produced potatoes and revealed the goal of tasting them.
reaction: Seeing the basket fill after the plants survived the storm is satisfying.
reason: The galley is the only available combination and has the equipment needed to prepare the harvest.
expectation: I expect to prepare and eat the potatoes, though I don't know exactly how the meal will be described.

effect: Roasting the potatoes completed the harvest and showed how the crop became a meal.
reaction: The quiet radio hiss makes the meal feel solitary despite the satisfying harvest.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting the potatoes was most worthwhile: seeing the basket fill paid off the long wait and the effort to keep the plants alive.

leastWorthwhile.text: The galley step was straightforward and offered no real decision, though the quiet meal was a fitting close.

surprise.text: The potatoes were larger than the seed pieces brought from Earth; I had not known what the harvest would yield.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the basket suited harvesting, and the galley had the equipment to prepare the crop.

continue.text: I would continue to learn what happens to the frozen discovery and whether Earth replies; the silent radio leaves me curious.
